title: Vector Warp
author: crypticevincar
selftext:
So, I done did a thing. In this game's earliest form, I was thinking about older space games like StarFlight where everything exists in a 2D plane. Travel is all up, down, left, right and you can get to every planet in the system. It's great, it's easy and it keeps you from having to pitch, yaw, roll, etc. I always wanted to have those planets further away. Something that did require some navigation to get to. But I wanted other objects in that same space to have that ability too. And then I did this. Is it revolutionary? No. Is it fun? Yes. To me. And hopefully to some others. Now since its earlier earliest design I've added, alien races, languages that must be learned and deciphered over time. Planetary landings, salvage wrecks, explorable derelicts in space, inter system travel, combat(still iffy on the combat). Finally cut a a trailer and put it on Youtube for ease of use. Used Claude multiple passes to get things looking and working exactly how I wanted, generate sound and music(as I couldn't find any I liked), write Blender scripts and even record, cut and create music specifically for the trailer. 

[Vector Warp](https://youtu.be/9JKqcyQVE58?si=o-u_vPyB0Ny6HqbS)

Game available on [Itch.io](http://Itch.io) \- [https://geekafied167.itch.io/vector](https://geekafied167.itch.io/vector)
